title: Small affine etale ringed model of an algebraic space
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and X an algebraic space over S, with its existing small etale site and structure sheaf [def-trf-algebraic-space] and module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the full subcategory of affine scheme charts in X_et. It is essentially small in the scheme universe u. Use Mathlib SmallModel and its inverse equivalence to include a small skeleton into X_et, with the induced topology and the actual regular-functions commutative structure sheaf. The regular-functions presheaf is a sheaf. Define module restriction along this inclusion, using the identity comparison of regular functions. It is an equivalence of module categories in the original section universe u; retain the resulting equivalence with this precise restriction functor.

source.place: Tags 03ED and 03G7; sites.tex Tag 039Z, comparison with an affine basis

proof.text: Retain the existing essential-smallness obligation for affine etale charts and the standard Mathlib SmallModel construction. Its remaining proof is the atlas-and-descent size bound stated in affineEtaleCharts_essentiallySmall. No alternative site or section universe is substituted.

For every etale chart T, take its scheme affine open cover. Compose each affine open map with the chart map to X; isEtale_comp and the scheme test of representable etaleness put each affine open in AffineEtaleCharts. The scheme maps form an etale jointly surjective covering presieve. The unit isomorphism of equivSmallModel factors every covering arrow through smallEtaleInclusion, so its coverByImage sieve covers. Fullness and faithfulness follow from those of the skeleton equivalence and the full-subcategory inclusion.

The small model topology is induced along this full faithful cover-dense functor, so Mathlib supplies IsDenseSubsite. Its structured-arrow indexing categories are small in universe u because the source model and chart Hom sets are u-small. Hence restriction of additive sheaves with section groups in universe u is an equivalence by Mathlib dense-subsite comparison. Apply lem-sfb-dense-subsite-module-extension with the original structure ring sheaf. The restriction ring map is definitionally the identity used by smallModuleRestriction. This proves its IsEquivalence instance and defines the stated equivalence.

The commutative regular-functions presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying ring presheaf is restriction of the original structure sheaf along the continuous induced-topology functor. Use Presheaf.isSheaf_of_isSheaf_comp with the forgetful functor from commutative rings to rings, and Functor.op_comp_isSheaf_of_isSheaf. This is the previously proved structure-sheaf obligation.

proof_origin.place: 03ED; actual affine-open cover with Mathlib dense-subsite comparison and 03D1/03D2 module-action transport. Essential smallness remains the original named obligation.
